intent: The search field of a Command, whose text filters the list.
typical_uses: The one-line search field above a CommandList

dont_use_when.situation: A search or text field that filters nothing in a Command

invariants.text: Without `value` the input holds the search text itself; with `value` the search text follows `value` and typing only reports the new text through `onValueChange`.

The input always renders as `type="text"` with `role="combobox"`, `aria-autocomplete="list"`, `aria-expanded="true"`, `aria-controls` pointing at the CommandList, `aria-activedescendant` pointing at the highlighted item and `aria-labelledby` pointing at the root's hidden label; these, `id`, `onChange` and autocomplete, autocorrect and spellcheck (all off) are set after the caller's props and cannot be overridden.
`className` reaches the input element and `wrapperClassName` the div around the decorative search icon and the input; command.module.css draws the bottom border on that div.

anti_patterns.dont: Listen to `onChange` for the search text
anti_patterns.do_instead: Use `onValueChange`, which receives the text; `onChange` is left out of the props type and replaced by the component's own

onValueChange.states: onValueChange is a callback called with the search text on every keystroke, not a value
onValueChange.because: `(search: string) => void` - a function, which no JSON Schema type covers.

unexposed_parts.part: The wrapper div and its search icon
unexposed_parts.reason: Fixed markup around the input; the icon is decorative (`aria-hidden`) and the div is styled only through `wrapperClassName`.

good.title: A search field with a placeholder
A search text the caller owns

bad.title: The search text read from the change event
bad.why: `onChange` is left out of CommandInput's props type, and at run time the component's own `onChange` replaces it, so this handler never runs; the text arrives through `onValueChange`.

onValueChange.description: TS: ((search: string) => void) | undefined. The compiler emits one JSON type per property; this type is left to tsc. onValueChange is a callback called with the search text on every keystroke, not a value. `(search: string) => void` - a function, which no JSON Schema type covers.
